note: Curated from public web pages only — not Facebook/X. Dates are as published on the linked source. Pins are venue/postcode centroids, not seat-accurate. Refresh weekly from the Paramount What’s On pages, Barnsley local markets, Barnsley events (my.barnsley.gov.uk filtered to Penistone), and the town council notices page. Skip TBC items and social-only listings.
